title: Teaching himself flute and Fireman Joyce's boys' band
summary: He played flute without lessons, joined the band organised by volunteer fireman Fireman Joyce at the home, and says he was in music before Happy Goldston.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Well, I mean did you play the flute without lessons?
Oh, the flute without lessons, yeah. Didn't know lessons for the flute.
Well, I mean, did you play the flute without lessons?
Oh, the flute without lessons, yeah. Didn't know lessons for the flute, yeah.
When did you start on the flute?

Well, I started the flute about a year or so ahead of that. Fireman Joyce took us in and he was there. Then Dave got this choice from the home, a fellow by the name of Dave. And he'd come up and make me up a band, and that's where I went in.
What did Fireman Joyce play again after that?
He didn't play anything. He just was a volunteer fireman.
Did he sing or do anything?

No, he didn't do anything. He just was an old volunteer fireman. And I think it's around the 12th of May today would be his day to parade. And he'd have nothing but boys out there. He made up his own band. He was a voice of, well, the other way is I was into music before Happy Goldson was.
